name: Wakazuma Hakuchuu no Himitsu
source:
Secret of a newly-wedded couple.
The husband doesn't know what his wife does during the day.

The young wife has few knowledge about sex.
Does she get absorbed in the new pleasure?
Or she keeps the love for her husband?
